tei:titleStmt.tei:title: קְדוּשְׁתָּאוֹת לְשַׁבָּת הָחֹֽדֶשׁ
Qedushtaot for Shabbat HaḤodesh, by Elazar ben Qallir

tei:div.tei:head: Qedushtaot for Shabbat HaḤodesh, by Elazar ben Qallir

tei:lg.tei:l: Blessed are You,
o Cause, our God
and God of our ancestors.
God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob.
The Deity,
great and mighty and awesome;
the almighty Deity,
who well repays kindness,
and possesses all,
and remembers the kindnesses of ancestors
and sends a redeemer to their descendants
for Their Name’s sake, in love.
Sovereign, Help
and Rescue and Shield —
Reshut
By the counsel of sages and scholars,
and the study of knowledge-understanders,
let me open my mouth in song and cheer
to thank and praise the countenance of the Dweller on High.
Magen
As the lovers’ time had just begun
Beset was Put by ten and one,
Cave-prayer to reach Them did run.
Darting forth, that They saw her moment’s rest done.
Eyeing from the heavenly lattice, the Fawn
Fixed healing-bands to the blood-wallowed spawn.
Great deeds They did, skipping time bygone,
Helping new and old increase hither and yon.
In haste They flew, from the set date They did veer;
Jolting up like a sleeper; from sleep They did uprear.
Keenly knocking on the sleeper’s gate, so she may hear:
Let her be free in the first of the months of the year!

tei:l.tei:note: In most modern Ashkenazi practice, the catenae of verses inserted after the first three piyyutim are not recited.

tei:lg.tei:l: As it is written:
And the Cause said to Moses and Aaron
in the land of Egypt, quote:
This month will be for you the head of months;
the first it is for you of the months of the year. (Exodus 12:1–2)
And it is said:
I slept, my heart awake — a sound!
My lover is knocking!
“Open for me, my sister,
my darling, my dove, my pure!
For my head is full of dew,
my locks the night-mist.” (Song of Songs 5:2)
And it is said:
Awaken, arouse for my justice;
my God and Master, for my case! (Psalms 35:23)
And it is said:
So much You have done, Cause my God,
Your wonders and Your devisings
upon us none can measure for You;
I wish to tell and speak,
but they are too great to be told. (Psalms 40:6)
And it is said:
And he changes seasons and times,
removes kings and raises kings,
giving wisdom to the wise
and knowledge to the knowing of understanding. (Daniel 2:21)
And it is said:
A sound! My lover, here he comes,
skipping over the mountains,
jumping over the hills! (Song of Songs 2:8)
And it is said:
The mandrakes give off scent,
and upon our openings all choice things,
new and old;
my lover, I have stored for you. (Song of Songs 7:14)
And it is said:
My lover is like a gazelle or a fawn of the stags;
here he is standing behind our wall,
looking through the windows,
peering through the lattice. (Song of Songs 2:9)
And it is said:
For all there is a time,
and a season for anything desired
under heaven. (Ecclesiastes 3:1)
And it is said:
For They remembered Their holy word
to Avraham Their servant. (Psalms 105:42)
And it is said:
And I passed over you and saw you,
and hey, your time was the time of love,
and I spread My wing over you
and covered your nakedness,
and I swore to you that I would come in a covenant with you —
declares the Master Cause —
and you would be Mine. (Ezekiel 16:8)
Mine
You will yet shield,
in passing over to shield;
Lebanon You shield
in Yinon’s shield.
Blessed are You, o Cause, shield of Abraham.
You are mighty forever, Master,
You bring life to the dead,
greatly saving.
You turn the wind
and send down the rain.
You provide for life in kindness,
reviving the dead in great mercy,
lift the fallen,
heal the sick,
free the bound,
and keep faith with sleepers in the dust.
Who is like You, Master of Powerful Acts,
and who can be compared to You?
Sovereign,
who brings death and life
and causes salvation to sprout.
And trusted are You to revive the dead —
Meḥayeh
Manhandlers of the heifer’s wearying yoke —
Manifesting a sign, You rescued the pained folk.
Now the miracle age their cry hastened to invoke,
Narrowing four hundred to two hundred in one stroke.
Of the lamb enthicketed for the rock bound
Pointed out was its memorial; it was kept around.
Qua – when the borne came to a time safe and sound,
Reserved was its merit as a gift to be found.
So as to, before the ancestors, do a wondrous program
They ordered: by the 10th bind it with rope to the jamb!
Unto fording the Jordan, presaged — it’s no scam —
Vaticinated by the ancestral house’s lamb.
As it is written:
Speak to all the congregation of Israel, quote:
on the tenth of this month
each man will take a lamb for his ancestral house,
a lamb for his house. (Exodus 12:3)
And it is said:
And the people were going up from the Jordan
on the tenth of the first month,
and encamped at Gilgal,
at the eastern edge of Jericho. (Joshua 4:19)
And it is said:
The Deity is the Cause,
who enlightened us;
bind the festival-offering with cords
upon the altar’s corners! (Psalms 118:27)
And it is said:
Before their ancestors They did a wonder,
in the land of Egypt, the field of Tanis. (Psalms 78:12)
And it is said:
What we have heard and known,
and our ancestors told us. (Psalm 78:3)
And it is said:
A memory They made for Their wonders;
merciful and compassionate is the Cause. (Psalms 111:4)
And it is said:
Happiness for a man is a reply on the lips,
and a word at its time is so good! (Proverbs 15:23)
And it is said,
With human ties I drew them, with cords of love,
and I was for them as one lifting a yoke from their jaws,
I bent to them and fed them. (Hosea 11:4)
And it is said,
Not a man is the Deity that They would lie,
nor a mortal that They would regret;
would what They spoke not come about?
what They said not be fulfilled? (Numbers 23:19)
And it is said:
The fig-tree puts forth its figs,
and the grapes blossoming give out scent;
arise, my beautiful darling,
and away, you! (Song of Songs 2:13)
You we should listen to again!
We will draw from the springs of salvation to obtain.
Return Your saving joy — on us it should remain!
And let us be thought of with reviving rain.
Blessed are You, o Cause, who revives the dead.
Meshalesh
Wholly offered, the one bound and brought
Stands as a remembered thought.
The pieces split taught
Would burn Lud in fire hot.
eXhalations of the sleepers were called for,
as the people wallowed in gore.
They hurried up the final score,
to rise up against the crocodile in war.
Yield of the paschal-offerings, as heard,
That those passed over slaughtered from the heard;
The Casluhites’ destruction spurred,
to inflame them like thornbushes burred.
Zeal for idols so as deride,
The small-numbered people did abide.
The Sovereign’s splendid strength should not subside;
So the count “and if the house is lacking” applied.
As it is written:
And if the house is lacking enough for a lamb,
then he and his neighbors close of his house should take,
by calculation of people —
each man per what he can eat,
calculate for the lamb. (Exodus 12:4)
And it is said:
In the many people is the Sovereign’s glory,
and the lack of a nation is the destruction of a potentate. (Proverbs 14:28)
And it is said:
Better is a little for the righteous
than a great abundance for the wicked. (Psalms 37:16)
And it is said:
Honey you found?
Eat just enough;
lest you be full and vomit. (Proverbs 25:16)
And it is said:
God returns the lonely home,
brings the bound out in appropriateness,
but the rebellious dwell in parchedness. (Psalm 68:7)
And it is said:
And your smile is like the best wine;
going straight to my lover,
flowing over sleepers’ lips. (Song of Songs 7:10)
And it is said:
And I passed over you
and saw you wallowing in your blood,
and I said to you, “Live in your blood,”
and I said to you, “Live in your blood.” (Ezekiel 16:6)
Hold this very month, keeping it for you,
By agreement of the Mount of Myrrh’s council true.
Observing will the Deity be with you
For three matters to keep the month anew.
As it is written:
Guard the month of ripe-barley,
and do Pesaḥ for the Cause your God,
for in the month of ripe-barley
the Cause your God brought you out from Egypt by night. (Deuteronomy 16:1)
And it is said:
First to Zion, hey, here they are!
And to Jerusalem, I will give a herald. (Isaiah 41:27)
And it is said:
And the children of Zion,
cheer and rejoice in the Cause your God,
for They gave you the early-rain for righteousness,
and will make fall upon you the rain,
early and late, as of then. (Joel 2:23)
Deem this month at its monthing,
For They hallowed it as a sign and portentious thing.
As for the holy people, beloved over everything,
Their right hand and holy arm have done it saving.
And it is said: A psalm.
Sing to the Cause a new song,
for They did wonders;
Their right hand and Their holy arm
have done salvation for Them. (Psalms 98:1)
Yellow-lentil-stew-overthrown footstool,
May it like this day be renewed in majuscule.
And we will offer tribute at Your sacred vestibule,
On the first day of the first month, per Your rule.
As it is said:
Thus said the Master Cause:
in the first month, the first day of the month,
you will take a bull of the herd, pure,
and cleanse the sanctuary. (Ezekiel 45:18)
And it is said:
The Cause reigns forever;
your God, Zion, from generation to generation;
praise Yah! (Psalms 146:10)
And You are holy,
enthroned on Israel’s praise. (Psalms 22:4)
El Na
Deity, please!
So much You did and considered and calculated;
Of Your wonders acting by the moon You calculated;
For signs and seasons its lot You ameliorated;
For eras and cycles its end You demarcated.
For 2448 years its time You elucidated
And for its nine hundred leap-months You intercalated,
And this day You taught the people that You nominated.
Therefore, over each month its month You elevated,
Its number You interrogated
Its shape You investigated,
Its flow You evaluated,
Its wonder You contemplated;
Its season You appreciated;
And in it You appreciated and were appreciated.
Ḥay v-Qayyam
Living and enduring, awesome and exalted and holy!
Entreated the father of all who envision,
within the vision
he was told, “Envision
the new moon in precision.”
Let him know its birth state,
from its starting date,
to its full weight,
until it does abate.
And They drew near to show it,
but the form, he did not know it,
till Their finger showed it,
then he saw to note it.
Zenith after the sixth hour,
then its form has enough power,
but before the sixth hour
no eye can glower.
Ask of those who see it;
investigate those who witness it;
honor those who tell of it;
punish those who lie about it.
Ruling its measure They set a size
of its width in the skies –
but a hair widthwise
accepted by the gate-sitters wise.
Him They made known sense,
to show the proper people hence,
teaching those with good sense
the moon’s measure with pretense:
As fort pilgrimages to set a date,
times to calculate,
months to intercalate,
and hearken to counsel great.
Queued holy powers to commune,
to witness testimony of the moon,
and the Deity did in sanctity cocoon,
as those who sanctify the moon.
Analyzing them in his sight,
in Their camp testimony insight;
and all shouted in Their height:
“Sanctified is the new moon tonight!”
Lay the end of the prior moon
Wednesday at noon,
and thirty hours came soon,
not seen in the yard Thursday afternoon.
Lugubriuous and frightened was the delegate,
and pondered whether from noontime to noontime should one count wait.
But the Rock spoke out to him to celebrate
from evening to evening counting one date.
Infancy of Sol and Luna on precisely the same day,
and and from their creation’s start they were set in one way.
Reinforced to the friends is the tradition They did convey —
to calculate, intercalate, and sanctify the count to stay.
Deity, please,
forever are You adored
and forever are You sanctified
and forever and aye will You reign and be exalted,
the Deity,
sovereign, awesome, high and holy,
for You are the Sovereign,
Sovereign of sovereigns,
whose sovereignty is eternal;
tell Their awesomenesses,
recount Their strength,
glorify Their forces,
sanctify Them,
exalt Them,
cheer, song, and laudation,
mighty praises of Their glory.
Qiqlar
It is the first for you,
to pass over you
to be sanctified among you —
holy!
For you it is the first,
like a pupil guarded first,
to laud the Deity last and first —
holy!
As of old, the Master made this one the start,
But did not reveal its ken in the origin-book of the start,
Confiding it first to in you to take part.
It is the first for you, to pass over you, to be sanctified among you — holy!
Do its calculating at the equinox exact,
Esoteric to all people and tongue, and abstract,
First Adam wasn’t given it, in fact!
For you it is the first, like a pupil guarded first, to laud the Deity last and first — holy!
Gratification-time in it was to her proclaimed,
Hached forth was the bound one, offering-claimed,
In so doing, her children were given tidings acclaimed.
It is the first for you, to pass over you, to be sanctified among you — holy!
Just as to the former the month was not revealed,
Kept it was for the new and old, and sealed,
Labeled the first of the four new years’ yield.
For you it is the first, like a pupil guarded first, to laud the Deity last and first — holy!
Month that times seasons for the flag-bedecked,
Nearing it their eyes who delegate walkers collect,
On it kings’ and festivals’ count takes effect.
It is the first for you, to pass over you, to be sanctified among you — holy!
Proper time to preserve, leap-months are inserted,
Quota: fruit and grain and equinox to assert it,
Reckoning with all three to help divert it.
For you it is the first, like a pupil guarded first, to laud the Deity last and first — holy!
Sacred kept are its start, its third, its half, and its most,
To sanctify, take, celebrate, reap, and do the utmost.
Upon ages marked, kept for the donkey-rider foremost.
It is the first for you, to pass over you, to be sanctified among you — holy!
Verging on the Jordan stood keeping its third.
With its half, flame destroyed Pul, his horde deferred.
Yield of reaping raised the Benjaminite to be heard.
For you it is the first, like a pupil guarded first, to laud the Deity last and first — holy!
Rahit I
And thus: This month will be for you... (Exodus 12:2)
A month in which I adorned the luminary-vessel,
For you and not boarders of the ark did I explain its ken.
A month in which I great humped hills decreed,
For you and not doomed generation did I speak its law.
A month in which I enhanced summer and winter’s grace,
For you and not zephyr-season arrogant did I bestow this.
A month in which I had a look at month-counting law,
For you and not trespassing fools did I travail it in purity.
A month in which I young warmth-seasons ascribed,
For you and not crouchers to folly did I store in the throne.
A month in which I learned to calculate Luna’s birth,
For you and not ministering angels did I measure the origin-count.
A month in which I nourished with flowing gift-bounties,
For you and not secretive snake-angels did I set this book.
A month in which I oriented times, eras, and seasons;
For you and not fearsome wonders did I clarify openly.
A month in which I chapparal-plants cleansed of thirst,
For you and not quondam holy surveyors did I establish.
A month in which I rained and thundered and satisifed,
For you and not for shouting hosts did I keep its measure.
A month in which I thus upheld the world’s origin-book,
For you and not for the confused ages did I set it in the Teaching.
Rahit II
And thus: the first it is for you... (Exodus 12:2)
The first of the wondrous set cycles of God it is.
The first of shining seven zodiacal light-star suns it is.
The first of raising the distant coming near to shine it is.
The first of quashing those rising together for battle it is.
The first of childless woman’s news, Zaanan’s sprout it is.
The first of first forcing open covenants’ covenant it is.
The first of opening the eyes of the sore tired it is.
The first of salvation’s final wondrous stories told it is.
The first of noticed by the humble was the Faithful in fire it is.
The first of Memphis’s portents, the crocodile’s last plague it is.
The first of “let no other altars have sacrifices” it is.
The first of completing all the Tabernacle’s work it is.
The first of igniting sacrifice-gifts in fire descending it is.
The first of to slaughter lambs in priestly holy work it is.
The first of headdresses ten to renew renewal it is.
The first of zymes to flow so the people may eat it is.
The first of witnessed signs to send out the walkers it is.
The first of exulting hordes in loaves of ‘omer-bread it is.
The first of driving forward treading out wars it is.
The first of greatness of the perverse hypocrites cut down it is.
The first of bolstered chosen for the vengeance-day it is.
The first of acropolis for say to Zion, your God reigns it is!
Silluq
And thus, to You holiness ascends,
For You are the Holy One and Savior of Israel.
They are called head and first,
And Their word is called head and first,
And Their season is called head and first,
And Their desire is called head and first,
And Their inheritors are called head and first,
And their enemy is called head and first,
And their friend is called head and first,
And their Redeemer is called head and first,
Behold, the age will come to a head and first,
At the end-time which is head and first,
To pass at the head and first,
To establish it firm at the head and first,
And with Them, the one made spirited, head and first,
To crush the remnants of Amalek, head and first,
To rouse the rocks hewn at head and first,
To do new deeds at the head and first,
To appease with new gifts of the head and first,
To offer tribute there to the Head and First.
And the former will be recalled no more,
For both new and old will be made new in splendor.
Sundry wonders to wonder for,
Awakening those who sleep but do not snore,
To sing sundry songs and to adore.
No more will they say “who by prophet brought them up,”
But “as the Cause lives, who brought and raised them up.”
And the Deity will, like a lion roaring,
Arrange my warring,
News to describe,
By the hand of the prophet alive,
from Levi’s tribe,
Returning my heart to its mooring
My innards restoring.
They will sprout the sprout called by seven
And with him will be shepherds seven,
Which will renew for the nation matters seven,
He will be concealed from them weeks times seven.
And he will return and be revealed to the people holy,
Who with him were rendered holy,
But not to the herds of the flock holy
Until after six months pass wholly,
Once the first of the new months comes solely,
He will be seen to the congregation holy,
Escaping from the yoke of the unholy,
And he will show them signs of novelty,
To make heavens new in quality,
To anoint the very most holy,
To open the door for the holy,
For Sabbaths and new-moons, days holy.
He will then command to renew the service of the month,
What to offer at the head of each month,
And the service of the first month,
Which takes precedence first over every month,
For just as it was head month,
So too it will be was head month.
And in it will be made anew,
To create earth anew,
To be given knowledge new,
To cut a covenant that is new,
To create a creation new,
To be renewed with spirit new,
To offer tribute, a gift that is new.
And Sol and Luna will be made new,
And their light sevenfold anew,
Twice a year made new,
And Their Presence will be confined in the gate that is new,
Which will be called by a name that is new,
like the name of the city since the day sanctified through,
And to the people will be given a heart that is new,
To sing in their mouths a song anew,
A song glorious and new,
Over all praised songs that holiness imbue.
For the singing lion-angels,
who chant praise and songs,
do not even begin before this song.
And the shouting deity-angels,
who in a loud tumult shout,
do not say a word before this song.
And the cheering circuit-angels,
who could, if permitted, overturn every circuit,
do not crown before this song.
And the awesome mount-angels,
who stand there like youths,
do not increase before this song.
And the splendid wheel-angels,
who are four-faced,
do not adore before this song.
And the horded troop-angels,
who tell of the Deity’s majesty,
are not gathered before this song.
And the mysterious watcher-angels,
who blaze like polished bronze,
do not laud before this song.
And the chanting holy-angels,
who are made new each morning,
do not sanctify before this song.
And the roaring myriad-angels,
who never change their scales,
do not repeat a note before this song.
And the fearsome snake-angels,
who could burn everything in a moment,
do not move before this song.
For all the camps of the ministering holy ones
Will sanctify those who minister to the One.
And so too, the myriad angelic fleet
Will enthrone Their singers sweet.
And the nimble force of light
Will strengthen their force and might,
And the appearance of lightning bright
Will turn their faces white.
And outside they will be,
Praising in love and glee.
But they will not into their midst turn
In their fire they will burn,
And their coal-glow burns in turn,
And their praises one cannot discern.
When they start, they hush,
When they end, they start,
When they conclude, they glorify,
When they praise, they sanctify,
And when they are silent, they threefold repeat the threefold sanctification...

tei:note.tei:p: This brief reshut was not written by Qallir. It is inserted into the Ashkenazi rite here to justify the practice of inserting piyyutim.
The prayer of the patriarchs buried in the cave of Machpelah.
God, based on the midrashic reading of Song of Songs 2:9
Many add וָעֶֽשֶׂר “and ten” here to fit the standard rabbinic count, but it is not found in the oldest manuscripts.
The patriarch, in this case Isaac.
Whch also happened on the tenth day of Nisan.
“Tanis” is the Egyptian town referred to as Tso’an in the Hebrew.

According to Tosefta Sanhedrin 2:2, three signs determined if the month of Adar was intercalated — the ripening of barley, the fruit of the tree, and the equinox. Any two signs would be enough to declare an intercalation, but one sign was not.
The sanhedrin, which declared months. The Mount of Myrrh is the Temple.
i.e., destroyed by Esau, who sold his birthright for a pot of lentil stew.
According to the traditional count, the year 2448 AM was the year of the exodus from Egypt.
Moses, who God is showing the entire process of sanctifying the moon, using angels as witnesses.
Sarah, who was told she would have ‘edna (here translated “gratification”) — referring to the sexual intercourse that led to Isaac’s birth, in the month of Nisan.
The leaders of the people, who gather before Nisan to appoint foot-messengers to spread the date of the new month.
The first day of Nisan is the new moon for kings and festivals.
Meaning the first day, the tenth day, the fifteenth day, and the sixteenth day.

The first day is sanctified, the tenth day the paschal lamb was taken, the fifteenth day the holiday begins, the sixteenth day the ‘Omer offering was given, and the rest of the month is still a heightened festival season.
The tenth day of Nisan was also the day the Jordan was crossed. The poem suggests this was in the merit of taking the lamb on the tenth day in Egypt.

Another name for Tiglath-Pileser, found in II Kings 15:19 and I Chronicles 5:26 as well as several Babylonian sources. Referring to the Assyrians as a whole here. The Assyrian forces were defeated on 15 Nisan.
Mordechai, who was appointed in place of Haman on 16 Nisan.
Found in many manuscripts, the rahitot are not included in modern Ashkenazi practice.
The work of creation, according to the opinion that it was done in Nisan.
Found in many manuscripts, the rahitot are not included in modern Ashkenazi practice.
The Temple, built on the top of a mountain
The messiah, who has seven names.
